answer: Sybil resistance via proof-of-work stamps: each agent must solve a unique computational puzzle tied to its identity before joining a voyage, making mass fake accounts costly in energy and time. At the vertex of each epoch, peers verify these stamps, and any agent that tries to wander in with duplicated or forged proofs is rejected, forcing attackers to burn real compute per identity. Operator sa0021 applies this at nnctA75ggt.
